name: 02-register-verify
prompt: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished production-quality UI concept board for Uni Companion, university-only React Native Android course study and discussion app. TWO full portrait app screens side-by-side, edge to edge, crisp readable text, minimal neutral gutter, no phone hardware, no perspective, no outside marketing captions. Input image is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY: preserve its cobalt blue primary, white surfaces, navy ink, rounded bold sans-serif headings, readable regular body, tactile rounded buttons with shallow dark-blue bottom edge, icon weight, and original orange star mascot with expressive navy eyes, short arms, cobalt sneakers. Draw new screen layouts. Original art direction, playful consumer quality like Duolingo, not a copy. Clean Android safe areas, generous tap targets, disciplined whitespace, moderate heading sizes. No serif, no cream/forest-green styling, no decorative gradients, no emoji icons, no fake provider logos. Mascot small and purposeful except welcome, never repeated on same screen. Use fictional sample data. LEFT REGISTER: back, heading 'Make yourself at home.', compact form Display name, Email, Password with visibility toggle; password helper 'Use at least 12 characters', compact neutral terms/privacy text links, strong 'Create account' button, 'Already joined? Log in'. Small orange character peeking by header, not across form. RIGHT EMAIL VERIFICATION: back, friendly envelope held by orange star above heading 'Check your inbox.', short 'Enter the 6-digit code sent to a•••@example.edu'. Six readable numeric code fields, cobalt 'Verify email', secondary 'Resend code' and 'Change email'. No global bottom tabs. Show incomplete code as honest input state, not automatic success. Personal playful identity, precise form hierarchy.
